description: One GitHub repository as Upstar sees it, the same facts as its Upstar page: stars and gains, its usual week, its star total week by week over 12 weeks, its topics and ranks, when Upstar spotted it, its latest release, license, activity and collections. Answers for every repository with an Upstar page, kept-out ones included; blocked ones have none.

detail.description: compact (the default): each repository's rank, name, description, language, stars, gains and Upstar page; full adds its creation day, health level, topics with their ranks and GitHub address, list_topics its categories, and get_repo its 12-week history, GitHub topics, activity counts and every period's ranks

lang.description: language of the names, descriptions and links Upstar writes: en (default at /mcp) or fr (default at /fr/mcp); repository descriptions stay as their authors wrote them

repo.description: the repository: owner/name, or its GitHub or Upstar address

name: get_repo

data_updated_at.description: when Upstar last rebuilt its rankings from GitHub's data (UTC, RFC 3339): every figure is as of then

lang.description: language of names and descriptions written by Upstar (en or fr)

method_url.description: Upstar's page explaining how stars are counted and repositories ranked

description.description: the repository's GitHub description, as its authors wrote it

health.description: Upstar's health level: healthy, mixed, low, new or archived (full detail; empty when not assessed)

rank.description: its rank in this list (a topic ranking keeps the topic's own ranks)

of.description: how many repositories rank in the topic over the period

ranks.description: its ranks in its topics: this week's (compact), or over 24 hours, 7 and 30 days (full)

growth.description: how many times its stars grew since

rank_when_spotted.description: its rank in that topic's weekly ranking then, any rank; absent when not kept (before November 2026) or the repo has left that topic

spotted_in.description: the topic it was first ranked in; absent when the repo has left that topic

spotted.description: when Upstar first ranked it, shown once its stars at least doubled

star_history.description: star total week by week over 12 weeks

stars.description: GitHub's star count as Upstar last read it

topics.description: its topics with its rank there this week (full detail)

usual_week.description: stars in a usual week: the median of the 8 weeks before this one

source.description: the source to cite when using these figures

title: A repository's facts
